map.根据缸径、行程、系统压力与活塞杆直径，计算推力、拉力、单行程容积与所需流量: From bore, stroke, system pressure, and rod diameter, compute thrust, pull, single-stroke volume, and required flow.
map.推力 F = P × π·D²/4；拉力 F_t = P × π(D²−d²)/: Thrust F = P × π·D²/4; pull F_t = P × π(D²−d²)/4
map.按缸径 D、活塞杆径 d 与系统压力 P 计算无杆腔/有杆腔输出力，结合行程 S: By bore D, rod diameter d, and system pressure P compute the cap-end / rod-end output force, then select by stroke S and stroke time t, and recommend rod type by speed ratio.
map.💡 推力 F₁=P×π/4×D²；拉力 F₂=P×π/4×(D²−d²)；流量: 💡 Thrust F₁ = P×π/4×D²; pull F₂ = P×π/4×(D²−d²); flow Q = V/t×60, V is the stroke volume.
map.活塞杆径一般取缸径的 0.3~0.7 倍，受拉工况取大值: Rod diameter is usually 0.3~0.7× bore; tension duty takes the larger end.
map.系统压力常用 16/21/25/31.5 MPa，中低压液压系统取低值: System pressure commonly 16/21/25/31.5 MPa; medium/low-pressure systems take the low end.
map.实际选型应考虑机械效率（约 0.9~0.95）及背压影响: Real selection should consider mechanical efficiency (~0.9~0.95) and back-pressure effects.
map.📚 深度解析：液压缸选型计算（推力/行程容积/流量）: 📚 Deep Dive: Hydraulic Cylinder Selection (thrust / stroke volume / flow)
map.液压系统设计：输入缸径、杆径、行程、压力与时间，算推拉力与需油量: Hydraulic system design: enter bore, rod, stroke, pressure, and time to compute force and oil demand.
map.速度校核：由流量与面积定伸出/缩回速度: Speed check: flow and area set extend / retract speed.
map.规格选型：推力关系负载与系统压力: Rating selection: thrust relates to load and system pressure.
map.算法：无杆腔面积 A1 = πD²/4、有杆腔 A2 = π(D²−d²)/4；: Algorithm: cap-end area A1 = πD²/4, rod-end area A2 = π(D²−d²)/4; thrust F = P×A/1000 (kN, P in MPa); stroke volume V = A×S/1e6 (L); flow Q = V/t×60 (L/min).
map.例：缸径 100mm、杆径 50mm、行程 500mm、压力 16MPa、时间: Example: bore 100 mm, rod 50 mm, stroke 500 mm, pressure 16 MPa, time 5 s → cap area 7854 mm², extend thrust 125.66 kN, retract 94.25 kN, stroke volume 3.927 L, extend flow 47.12 L/min (retract 35.34 L/min). If bore 80, rod 45, stroke 400, pressure 20, time 4 s → thrust 100.53 kN, flow 30.16 L/min.
map.有杆腔推力为何小？: Why is the rod-end thrust smaller?
map.有杆腔有效面积少了活塞杆截面，故缩回推力小于伸出；双向负载差异大时须分别校核两腔: The rod-end effective area loses the rod cross-section, so retract thrust is less than extend; for large two-way load differences both ends must be checked separately.
map.流量决定伸出速度？: Does flow set the extend speed?
map.速度 = 流量/面积；同流量下缸径越小速度越快，须与泵流量、阀通径匹配。: Speed = flow / area; at the same flow a smaller bore is faster and must match pump flow and valve port size.
